description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Scroll up or down by `distance` window heights (0 < distance <= 3, default 0.5) using trackpad-style scroll events. Refused with mirror_not_live or mirror_state_unknown when the mirror is not live or its state cannot be confirmed; reports scroll_no_effect when the screen did not change (list end, or the view does not scroll). Optional expect: text that must be on screen (OCR) first, else nothing is sent. Reports delivery and retry.
name: phone_scroll
